title: Machine-learning surrogate optimized a simulated asymmetric III-nitride tunnel junction
summary: A machine-learning surrogate trained on TCAD simulations was used to design an asymmetric III-nitride tunnel junction with lower simulated resistance. The paper reports a computational device-design result without fabricated-device measurement.
ai_technology: Machine-learning surrogate trained on technology computer-aided design simulations.
organization: Not stated in the abstract reviewed

evidence.tested: Simulated junction designs were compared on predicted resistance; the reported optimized asymmetric design had lower simulated resistance.
evidence.unknown: Simulation-only design; fabricated-device performance and experimental validation were not reported.
evidence.ai_role: Machine-learning surrogate trained on technology computer-aided design simulations.
